lies.speaker: Silas
lies.said: Elsie's gone and I'll say it plain: I walk this square every night and I've seen things that don't add up. Pia, your boat lights were out past midnight. Tess, you're quick with words for someone who keeps her head down. Don't hide behind politeness. Who was out after Dusk?

lies.speaker: Hugo
lies.said: Elsie taught me long enough to deserve better than gossip. Umar, you asked what I saw: nothing. My schoolhouse shutters were closed by Dusk and the fog hid the lane.
